g.text: C4 bias sweeps expose a tradeoff that validation selection does not fully recover
Each sweep holds the internally selected lambda for each fold/seed/view and changes only the preregistered gamma.

g.text: Square markers: registered selected methods. Hollow circles: fixed-gamma outer diagnostic; NOT used to replace selected C4.
ONE gamma=0.4 gives H=0.0532 (Z0: 0.0495), but retains only 72.5% of Z0 unseen MRR; the registered 80% criterion is still unmet.
Formal C4 uses fold-specific internally chosen gamma. Sweep bars show 3-seed SD; no post-hoc selection or AUC; all results are development only.
